entries.docstring:
The label encoding is not injective: two different display names of one driver encode to the
same stored name, so the second is a name conflict.

The contract accepts a fractional `cpu` (`0.5`), but `runtime_profiles.cpu` is a PostgreSQL
`integer`, which cannot store it.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptConfiguration.contract_size_bound_exceeds_the_integer_column
entries.docstring:
The contract bounds the sizing and timeout fields by `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` ("no ceiling"), but the
four columns are PostgreSQL `integer`s: `2^31` passes the contract and overflows the column.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptConfiguration.decoded_driver_may_be_outside_the_catalogue
entries.docstring:
`decodeDriver` does not check the catalogue: a stored name with the runtime-connection prefix
and an unknown driver segment lists as a connection whose driver the contract rejects.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptConfiguration.image_rule_ignores_the_driver
entries.docstring:
The create-time image rule does not read the driver: a `local` profile with a tagged image is
refused exactly like a `docker` one, although the error says "non-local runtime profiles".

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptConfiguration.model_connection_credential_has_no_foreign_key
entries.docstring:
No foreign key joins `model_connections` and `secrets` in either direction: a connection's
credential is found by the name `MODEL_CONNECTION_<id>` alone.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptConfiguration.model_connection_name_has_no_database_check
entries.docstring:
A runtime profile's name must not be blank and a secret's name has a shape, but a model
connection's name has no database check at all: only the route refuses a blank one.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptConfiguration.only_the_profile_resource_carries_workspace_id
entries.docstring:
Of the configuration resources, only the runtime profile carries its `workspaceId` on the wire;
the model-connection, secret and runtime-connection resources do not.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptConfiguration.reserved_names_are_ordinary_secret_names
entries.docstring:
The secrets route accepts the names reserved for model-connection credentials and runtime
connections, including the forged runtime-connection name the code comment measures: the
reservation is a naming convention only.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptConfiguration.runtime_connection_create_ignores_unknown_fields
entries.docstring:
The runtime-connection create parser accepts its full body with an unknown key added, while the
model-connection, secret and runtime-profile create parsers refuse their full bodies with the same
key.

entries.docstring: A runtime connection has no table and no identifier kind of its own: it is a `secrets` row.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptConfiguration.secret_references_disagree_on_delete
entries.docstring:
The references into `secrets` disagree on deletion: a runtime profile's is cleared
(`SET NULL`), a connector's credential blocks it (`RESTRICT`), so deleting a secret can be
refused.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptConfiguration.set_null_alone_breaks_the_default_model_pair
entries.docstring:
Clearing only the connection of a workspace default (what the key's own `ON DELETE SET NULL`
does) breaks `workspaces_default_model_pair`; the repository therefore clears both columns first.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptIdentity.admitted_slugs_are_shorter_than_the_contract_bound
entries.docstring:
Every slug the database admits has at most 63 characters, one fewer than the contract's
bound.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptIdentity.blank_checks_admit_whitespace_other_than_spaces
entries.docstring:
The database's not-blank checks (`length(btrim(x)) > 0`) strip only spaces, so a name of tabs
or line feeds passes them, while the routes trim all whitespace before writing.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptIdentity.core_source_xor_differs_from_sql_at_null_kind
entries.docstring:
`Er/Core.lean`'s `principalSourceXor` passes every row whose `kind` is `NULL`, but SQL's
three-valued reading of `workspace_principals_source_xor` is `FALSE` on a row with no kind and no
source. The two agree on every row with a kind (`source_xor_refines_core`), and `kind` is
`NOT NULL`, so the difference is unreachable in a consistent state.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptIdentity.from_directory_record_accepts_an_incoherent_record
entries.docstring:
`Principal.fromDirectoryRecord` copies `userId` and `apiKeyId` without checking them against
the kind, so an incoherent record builds a frozen principal that `isPrincipal` then refuses.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptIdentity.slug_bound_is_off_by_one
entries.docstring:
The contract bounds a workspace slug at 64 characters, but the database's slug check admits at
most 63: a 64-character slug passes `POST /api/workspaces`'s length bound and is refused by
`workspaces_slug_format`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptPublication.a_member_cannot_read_another's_workspace_share
entries.docstring:
A Builder or Viewer never lists a `workspace` share that another principal published, and the
public link never opens it, so today no member other than its publisher and the Owners and Admins
can read a workspace share, contrary to the specification's "any member of the workspace"
(finding 1).

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptPublication.a_space_subject_id_passes_validation_but_not_the_database
entries.docstring:
A subject id of one space is non-empty, so the request and resource schemas' `min(1)` accept
it, yet the database's `length(btrim(subject_id)) > 0` refuses it, so the insert fails after
validation passed (finding 3). A tab, which `btrim` keeps, passes both.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptPublication.budget_is_not_tied_to_runnable_mode_in_the_database
entries.docstring:
The database ties a mode to agent shares (`shares_agent_mode_only`) but ties no budget to
runnable mode: a project share with a budget cap passes every database check, although the
documents reserve `budget_cap_usd` for runnable links and the service never writes such a share
(finding 5).

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptPublication.private_and_workspace_shares_list_alike
entries.docstring:
A private and a workspace share with the same publisher are listed for exactly the same
callers: the list filter reads the role and the publisher, never the visibility (finding 1).

entries.docstring:
A workspace share and a private share are both refused by the public link at every instant,
so the only difference between the two visibilities is the stored word (finding 1).

The specification's column list for `shares` omits six columns of today's table (`token`,
`subject_label`, `stopped`, `publisher_principal_id`, `suspended_at`, `created_at`), and today's

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptWork.audit_actor_key_is_recorded_as_no_action
entries.docstring:
The catalogue, like `drizzle-kit`'s 0025 snapshot, records `NO ACTION` for the audit trail's
actor-principal key, while migration 0020 deploys `ON DELETE SET NULL (actor_principal_id)`
(Drizzle's DSL cannot express a column-list `SET NULL`).

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptWork.blank_checks_trim_spaces_only
entries.docstring:
The "not blank" checks use one-argument `btrim`, which strips spaces only: a name or label of
tabs or line breaks passes the database, although the project routes refuse it (they test
`name.trim()`, which strips all white space). The database is weaker than the route.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptWork.database_admits_a_foreign_sdk_session_id
entries.docstring:
The database admits a session whose SDK session id is not its platform id, although today's
application only ever records the platform id there (`recordReportedSessionIdentity`): the
identity invariant is not a database constraint.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ConceptWork.database_admits_a_transcript_under_another_key
entries.docstring:
The database admits a transcript whose `project_key` is not its `workspace_id`, although the
contract says the key "is the caller's workspace id by construction" and the repository refuses
any other: the invariant lives only in the repository.

entries.docstring:
The ledger's "recorded, at `cost_usd = '0'`" rule for unpriced responses is kept by the
repository only: a ledger row with no price table version and a nonzero cost passes every
`run_usage_records` check while breaking the rule.

connectors, projects, sessions, runs, shares"), `runs` has no owner column: a run is owned through

id (`:engineSessionId`): only the identity invariant makes the two the same value.

entries.docstring:
`docs/architecture.md` says the two-file Drizzle cycle "expresses the tenant-scoped composite
foreign keys in both directions"; only one direction is composite (finding 6): `workspaces`
references its default connection through the composite key paired on its own `id` (with a
single-column `SET NULL` sibling), while `model_connections` references `workspaces` through the
single-column `workspace_id` root reference, which no composite key accompanies.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ErCore.primary_keys_other_than_id
entries.docstring:
The `columns.ts` comment says "Every table's primary key is a database-generated UUID"; thirteen
tables are keyed otherwise (finding 4): the agent-version pointers (one per agent and
environment), the endpoint client's agents and its bound API keys (one binding per key), the two

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Meta.ErCore.unexecutable_set_null_keys
entries.docstring:
`ON DELETE SET NULL` nulls every column of the key. Exactly two keys of today's schema are
composite `SET NULL` keys that include the `NOT NULL` `workspace_id`, so the action they declare
cannot execute: deleting the parent fails with a `NOT NULL` violation instead (finding: see
`docs/formal/units/er-core.md`). Every other `SET NULL` key is executable.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.engine_catalogue_is_read_by_every_role
entries.docstring:
`GET /api/engines` (ENG-02c, #319) is read by every one of §21's four roles and written by
none of the three narrower ones, whatever ownership the handler reports.

The ownership quantifier is the point rather than a flourish. The catalogue is deployment
configuration: it names no row, so the handler always answers `not-applicable`, and a grant of
`any` is what makes that answer irrelevant — a reader gets the same decision for every ownership
the handler could conceivably produce. `write: none` for admin, builder and viewer says the other
half: an engine is installed by deploying an adapter, and no route writes one. Owner keeps §21's
`Everything.` fallback and is therefore deliberately absent from the write half.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.run_routes_read_and_interrupt_by_role
entries.docstring:
The run row of the matrix, read through `decide()` on the real run paths: reading a run or its
events — Owner and Admin any, Builder and Viewer own; interrupting and rating (feedback, S2-05c) —
Owner and Admin any, Builder and Viewer own; for each role,
`[own, other, unknown, not-applicable, permitted]`.

entries.statement: ∀ (run : AgentWorkspace.RunId) (id : String) (sub : Option String), AgentWorkspace.Authz.TokenScope.checkTokenScope (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.Scope.run run) AgentWorkspace.Authz.Resources.Resource.runs AgentWorkspace.Authz.Permissions.Operation.read sub (some id) = if AgentWorkspace.Authz.TokenScope.sameRunId (some id) run.val = true then none else some AgentWorkspace.Authz.TokenScope.ScopeDenial.runIdMismatch
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.run_scope_needs_the_exact_run_id
entries.docstring: A run scope admits the same row by exact spelling or equivalent valid UUID spelling.

entries.statement: ∀ (k : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.ScopeKind), ((List.filter (fun x => x.fst == k) AgentWorkspace.Authz.TokenScope.documentedScopeRoutes).all fun x => match x with | (fst, m, p) => match AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.parsePath p with | AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.ParsedPath.ok r sub id => match AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.parseOperation m sub with | AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.ParsedOperation.ok op => AgentWorkspace.Authz.TokenScope.inGrammar k r op sub | AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.ParsedOperation.refused m => false | x => false) = true ∧ ((AgentWorkspace.Authz.TokenScope.grammar k).all fun x => match x with | (r, o, s) => (List.filter (fun x => x.fst == k) AgentWorkspace.Authz.TokenScope.documentedScopeRoutes).any fun x => match x with | (fst, m, p) => match AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.parsePath p with | AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.ParsedPath.ok r' sub id => match AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.parseOperation m sub with | AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.ParsedOperation.ok op => r' == r && op == o && (s.isNone || s == sub) | AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.ParsedOperation.refused m => false | x => false) = true
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.scope_grammar_is_the_documented_route_table
entries.docstring:
§3.1.1's grammar table, read route by route through `parsePath` and `parseOperation`, agrees
with `TOKEN_SCOPE_GRAMMAR` in both directions for each kind: every documented route lands in a cell
of its kind's grammar (`inGrammar`), and every cell is witnessed by a documented route of that kind
— same resource and operation, and, for a sub-keyed cell such as `(runs, run, "feedback")`, the
same sub-resource.

entries.statement: ∀ (s : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.Scope) (sub : Option String), AgentWorkspace.Authz.TokenScope.checkTokenScope s AgentWorkspace.Authz.Resources.Resource.runs AgentWorkspace.Authz.Permissions.Operation.read sub none = some AgentWorkspace.Authz.TokenScope.ScopeDenial.collectionRead
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.scoped_collection_read_is_out_of_scope
entries.docstring:
"A scope reads one row, never a collection": a scoped `runs` read that names no `:id` is
denied with `token_out_of_scope`, for both kinds.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.session_scope_defers_row_identity
entries.docstring:
"A session scope's row identity … is checked where the row is read": the scope check admits a
session scope's run read, agent run and run feedback for any path id, leaving the row check to the
handler.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.unclassified_sub_is_refused_not_inherited
entries.docstring:
An unclassified sub-resource is refused, never given its parent's grant: `decide()` answers
`refuse` for it whoever asks, whatever the method, ownership or scope.

entries.statement: ∀ (m : String) (sub : Option String), ¬m ∈ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.methods → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.parseOperation m sub = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.ParsedOperation.refused AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.MethodRefusal.unknownMethod
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.unknown_method_is_refused
entries.docstring:
A method outside `METHODS` (lower-case `get`, `TRACE`, the empty string, …) yields no
operation, so `decide()` refuses it.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.unknown_resource_is_refused_first
entries.docstring: An unclassified resource segment is refused before depth or sub-resource are looked at.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.unknown_role_is_refused
entries.docstring:
An unrecognised role is refused before anything else is looked at, never downgraded to a
narrower role — even on the public surface.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzDecide.uppercase_run_uuid_keeps_scope
entries.docstring: Uppercase path spelling of a valid run UUID is the same scoped row.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzRunToken.gateway_error_envelope
entries.docstring: Gateway refusal uses the stable authentication error envelope.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzRunToken.gateway_error_order
entries.docstring: Gateway authentication returns the first applicable public failure in its defined order.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzRunToken.invalid_verdict_precedes_expiry
entries.docstring: Bad signatures or claims stay invalid even when the token is also expired.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzRunToken.revocation_outcomes
entries.docstring: Revoking a token distinguishes absent, active, and already revoked rows.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzRunToken.runner_principal_checks_run_row
entries.docstring: Runner authentication requires the token's scoped identity to match the run row.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzRunToken.runner_principal_checks_session
entries.docstring: A runner principal requires the persisted session id to match its signed claim.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzRunToken.verification_expires_at_boundary
entries.docstring: Verification accepts the final pre-expiry second and rejects the expiry instant.

entries.statement: ∀ (repo : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.WorkspaceRepo) (id : String) (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal) (directory : List AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.MemberSummary), AgentWorkspace.Uuid.isCanonical id = true → p.via = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.Via.apiKey → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.memberResolver repo id p directory = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome.refuse 403 "api_key_not_permitted" ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ownerResolver repo id p directory = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome.refuse 403 "api_key_not_permitted"
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.api_key_caller_is_refused_on_workspace_routes
entries.docstring:
Every workspace route refuses an API-key caller with `403 api_key_not_permitted` (for a
well-formed id), before any membership is read.

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (keyHash : String) (now : Nat), (∀ (pr : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), pr ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals → (pr.get "revoked_at").isSome = true) → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.authenticateApiKey st keyHash now = none
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.api_key_of_a_revoked_principal_selects_no_workspace
entries.docstring:
An API key whose workspace principal is revoked selects no workspace, even while the key row
itself is live.

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (keyHash : String) (now : Nat) (i : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ApiKeyIdentity), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.authenticateApiKey st keyHash now = some i → ∃ k, k ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.apiKeys ∧ k.get "key_hash" = some keyHash ∧ k.get "workspace_id" = some (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.fromApiKey i).workspaceId ∧ ∃ pr, pr ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals ∧ pr.get "id" = some (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.fromApiKey i).principalId ∧ pr.get "workspace_id" = some (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.fromApiKey i).workspaceId
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.api_key_principal_is_in_the_key_workspace
entries.docstring:
An API key selects the workspace it was minted in: the principal's workspace is the key row's
(the one whose hash was presented), and its principal row is paired with the key in that same
workspace.

entries.statement: ∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal) (resolve : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome) (o : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Ownership), resolve p = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome.ownership o → ∀ (decideFn : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Ownership → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Decision), (∀ (f : Option AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.RouteFacts), decideFn p o = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Decision.allow f → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.authoriseFlow true (some p) resolve decideFn = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.AuthoriseResult.allowed o) ∧ (∀ (f : Option AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.RouteFacts), decideFn p o = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Decision.deny f none → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.authoriseFlow true (some p) resolve decideFn = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.AuthoriseResult.problem 403 "forbidden") ∧ (∀ (f : Option AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.RouteFacts) (sd : AgentWorkspace.Authz.TokenScope.ScopeDenial), decideFn p o = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Decision.deny f (some sd) → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.authoriseFlow true (some p) resolve decideFn = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.AuthoriseResult.problem 403 "token_out_of_scope") ∧ ∀ (r : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.RefuseReason), decideFn p o = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Decision.refuse r → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.authoriseFlow true (some p) resolve decideFn = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.AuthoriseResult.problem 500 "authorisation_undecidable"
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.authorise_follows_decide_after_an_ownership
entries.docstring:
When the resolver answers an ownership, `authorise` follows `decide()`: allow runs the handler
with that ownership, deny is `403` with the decision's code (`token_out_of_scope` for a scope
denial, otherwise `forbidden`), and refuse is `500 authorisation_undecidable` — a deny is never
turned into a `404`.

entries.statement: ∀ (principal : Option AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal) (resolve : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome) (decideFn : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Ownership → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Decision), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.authoriseFlow false principal resolve decideFn = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.AuthoriseResult.problem 503 "rbac_runtime_not_configured" ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.authoriseFlow true none resolve decideFn = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.AuthoriseResult.problem 401 "unauthenticated"
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.authorise_refuses_before_resolving
entries.docstring:
Before any resolver or `decide()` runs, `authorise` answers `503 rbac_runtime_not_configured`
when the runtime is not wired and `401 unauthenticated` when no principal was identified.

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (tokenHash : String) (now : Nat) (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.resolveBrowserToken st tokenHash now = some p → ∀ (rid : AgentWorkspace.RunId), p.scope = some (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.Scope.run rid) → ∃ r, r ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.runs ∧ r.get "id" = some rid.val ∧ r.get "workspace_id" = some p.workspaceId ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.runTerminal r = false
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.browser_token_for_a_run_requires_a_live_run
entries.docstring:
A run-scoped browser token selects a workspace only while its run exists in the token's
workspace and has not reached a terminal status (`cancelled`, `completed`, `failed`).

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (tokenHash : String) (now : Nat) (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.resolveBrowserToken st tokenHash now = some p → ∀ (sid : AgentWorkspace.SessionId), p.scope = some (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.Scope.session sid) → ∃ se, se ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.sessions ∧ se.get "id" = some sid.val ∧ se.get "workspace_id" = some p.workspaceId ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.colIs se "status" "archived" = false
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.browser_token_for_a_session_requires_a_live_session
entries.docstring:
A session-scoped browser token selects a workspace only while its session exists in the token's
workspace and is not archived.

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (tokenHash : String) (now : Nat) (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.resolveBrowserToken st tokenHash now = some p → ∃ b, b ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.browserTokens ∧ b.get "token_hash" = some tokenHash ∧ b.get "workspace_id" = some p.workspaceId ∧ b.get "minted_by_principal_id" = some p.principalId ∧ p.via = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.Via.browserToken ∧ p.scope.isSome = true
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.browser_token_principal_is_in_the_token_workspace
entries.docstring:
A browser token selects its minter's workspace, which is the token row's own: the principal is
the minter's (re-read in the token's workspace) with the token's scope attached.

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (tokenHash : String) (now : Nat) (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.resolveBrowserToken st tokenHash now = some p → (∃ pr, pr ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals ∧ pr.get "id" = some p.principalId ∧ pr.get "workspace_id" = some p.workspaceId ∧ pr.get "revoked_at" = none) ∧ (p.kind = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.Kind.apiKey → ∃ k, k ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.apiKeys ∧ k.get "workspace_id" = some p.workspaceId ∧ k.get "id" = p.apiKeyId ∧ k.get "role" = some p.role ∧ k.get "revoked_at" = none ∧ ((k.get "expires_at").isNone = true ∨ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.after (k.get "expires_at") now = true)) ∧ (p.kind = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.Kind.membership → ∃ m, m ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.memberships ∧ m.get "workspace_id" = some p.workspaceId ∧ m.get "role" = some p.role)
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.browser_token_selection_requires_a_live_minter
entries.docstring:
A browser token selects a workspace only while its minting principal is unrevoked in the token's
workspace and, for a key-minted token, while the minting API key itself is neither revoked nor
expired; the role it carries is the one the directory holds now (the member's current membership
role, or the key's role): revoking the minting key or principal, or demoting the minting member,
takes effect on the token's next call.

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (tokenHash : String) (now : Nat) (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.resolveBrowserToken st tokenHash now = some p → ∃ b, b ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.browserTokens ∧ b.get "token_hash" = some tokenHash ∧ b.get "revoked_at" = none ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.after (b.get "expires_at") now = true
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.browser_token_selection_requires_a_live_token
entries.docstring:
A browser token selects a workspace only while it is live: its row is unrevoked and its expiry
is after `now` (an expired or revoked token authenticates as nothing).

entries.statement: ∀ (acceptWs : String → Bool) (ws : String), acceptWs ws = true → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.scopedObjectOp acceptWs ws (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOp.put "") = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOutcome.unsafeKey AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.emptyKey ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.scopedObjectOp acceptWs ws (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOp.get "") = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOutcome.unsafeKey AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.emptyKey ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.scopedObjectOp acceptWs ws (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOp.delete "") = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOutcome.unsafeKey AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.emptyKey ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.scopedObjectOp acceptWs ws (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOp.copy "" "a") = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOutcome.unsafeKey AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.emptyKey ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.scopedObjectOp acceptWs ws (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOp.copy "a" "") = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOutcome.unsafeKey AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.emptyKey ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.scopedObjectOp acceptWs ws (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOp.list "") = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOutcome.backend ["workspaces/" ++ ws] ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.scopedObjectOp acceptWs ws (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOp.listPrefix "") = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ObjectOutcome.backend ["workspaces/" ++ ws]
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.empty_key_is_refused_except_as_the_root_listing
entries.docstring:
The empty key, which would name the workspace root itself, is refused as `empty-key` for a put,
get, delete and either side of a copy, and is accepted only as a listing prefix, where it lists the
workspace's own root `workspaces/<ws>`.

entries.statement: ∀ (t now : Nat), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.after (some (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Workspace.instantText t)) now = true ↔ now < t
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.expiry_instant_is_exclusive
entries.docstring:
An expiry cell is exclusive: a credential whose `expires_at` is the instant `t` is live at
`now` exactly when `now < t` (`gt(expires_at, now)`), so at its expiry instant it is already dead.

entries.statement: AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard ".." false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.dotSegment ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "a/../b" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.dotSegment ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "a/./b" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.dotSegment ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "a//b" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.emptySegment ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "a/" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.emptySegment ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "x/__objectstore_meta__" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.reservedName ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "x/a__OBJECTSTORE_META__.json" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.reservedName ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "/etc/passwd" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.absolute ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "C:/x" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.absolute ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "a\\b" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.backslash ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "a\x00b" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.controlCharacter ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "w1/..%2f..%2fetc" false = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.KeyRule.percentEncoded ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "..config/x.txt" false = Except.ok "..config/x.txt" ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.keyGuard "...hidden/y" false = Except.ok "...hidden/y"
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.key_guard_refuses_each_named_traversal
entries.docstring:
The guard's named refusals, each on its own key (ADR W2-CP-03's list): a `..` or `.` segment
(`dot-segment`), an empty segment (`empty-segment`), the metadata marker in any case
(`reserved-name`), a leading `/` or drive letter (`absolute`), a backslash, a control character and
a percent-encoded traversal; while `..config/x.txt` and `...hidden/y` stay legal.

entries.statement: ∀ (repo : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.WorkspaceRepo) (id : String) (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal) (directory : List AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.MemberSummary) (u role : String), AgentWorkspace.Uuid.isCanonical id = true → p.via ≠ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.Via.apiKey → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.resolveMemberUserId directory p.actor = some u → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.getForMember repo id u = some role → role ≠ "owner" → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ownerResolver repo id p directory = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome.ownership AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Ownership.other ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.memberResolver repo id p directory = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome.ownership AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Ownership.own
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.lesser_member_is_measured_not_concealed
entries.docstring:
A workspace the caller belongs to with a lesser role is measured, not concealed: the owner
resolver answers `other` (so `decide()`'s `403` applies) while the member resolver answers `own`.

entries.statement: ∀ (repo : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.WorkspaceRepo) (id : String) (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal) (directory : List AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.MemberSummary), AgentWorkspace.Uuid.isCanonical id = false → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.memberResolver repo id p directory = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome.refuse 404 "workspace_not_found" ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ownerResolver repo id p directory = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome.refuse 404 "workspace_not_found"
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.malformed_workspace_id_is_not_found_for_every_caller
entries.docstring:
A workspace route answers `404 workspace_not_found` for a path id that is not a canonical UUID,
for every caller — an API key included: the id check comes before the API-key refusal.

entries.statement: ∀ (repo : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.WorkspaceRepo) (id : String) (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal) (directory : List AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.MemberSummary), AgentWorkspace.Uuid.isCanonical id = true → p.via ≠ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.Via.apiKey → (∀ (u : String), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.resolveMemberUserId directory p.actor = some u → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.getForMember repo id u = none) → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.memberResolver repo id p directory = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome.refuse 404 "workspace_not_found" ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ownerResolver repo id p directory = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome.refuse 404 "workspace_not_found"
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.non_member_or_absent_workspace_is_not_found
entries.docstring:
A workspace the caller does not belong to answers exactly as one that does not exist: for a
well-formed id and a caller that is not an API key, when the caller's email names no member, or the
member it names holds no membership of that workspace (because there is none, or because the
workspace does not exist), both resolvers answer `404 workspace_not_found` — never `403`.

entries.statement: ((List.range 128).all fun n => have c := Char.ofNat n; AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.sdkProjectDirName (String.singleton c) == (decide (48 ≤ n) && decide (n ≤ 57) || decide (65 ≤ n) && decide (n ≤ 90) || decide (97 ≤ n) && decide (n ≤ 122) || n == 95 || n == 45)) = true
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.project_key_character_class
entries.docstring:
A project key's characters are `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` and nothing else: every one of the 128 ASCII
characters is accepted as a one-character key exactly when it is a letter, a digit, `_` or `-`
(ranges transcribed independently of `Text`).

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.project_key_is_one_to_sixty_four_characters
entries.docstring:
A project key is 1 to 64 characters (`{1,64}`): the empty key and a 65-character key are
refused as `projectKeyPattern`, a 1-character and a 64-character key are accepted.

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (key : String) (s : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.WorkspaceScope), (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.forWorkspaceId st key = some s → ∃ r, r ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspaces ∧ r.get "id" = some key ∧ s.workspaceId = key) ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.forWorkspaceSlug st key = some s → ∃ r, r ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspaces ∧ r.get "slug" = some key ∧ r.get "id" = some s.workspaceId)
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.resolved_scope_names_an_existing_workspace
entries.docstring:
A resolver mints a scope only after a `workspaces` row answered: by id, the row with that id;
by slug, the row with that slug, whose id the scope carries.

entries.statement: ∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal) (resolve : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome) (status : Nat) (code : String), resolve p = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.ResolverOutcome.refuse status code → ∀ (decideFn : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Ownership → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Decide.Decision), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.authoriseFlow true (some p) resolve decideFn = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.AuthoriseResult.problem status code
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.resolver_refusal_bypasses_decide
entries.docstring:
When an ownership resolver refuses, `authorise` returns the resolver's result as it is and
never consults `decide()`: whatever `decide()` would say, the answer is the same.

entries.statement: ∀ (ws role runId : String), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.runPreflight AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RunRoute.revokeTokens { workspaceId := ws, role := role, browserScoped := true } runId = some { status := 403, code := "token_out_of_scope", message := "a browser token’s scope does not reach revoking run tokens." }
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.revoke_tokens_refuses_a_browser_token_first
entries.docstring:
`revokeRunTokens` refuses a browser-token caller with `403 token_out_of_scope` first: whatever
its role and whatever the path id (well-formed or not), a scoped caller never reaches the role gate,
the id check or the run lookup.

entries.statement: ∀ (ws role runId : String), role ≠ "owner" ∧ role ≠ "admin" → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.runPreflight AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RunRoute.revokeTokens { workspaceId := ws, role := role, browserScoped := false } runId = some { status := 403, code := "run_token_revoke_forbidden", message := "only a workspace owner or admin may revoke active run tokens." }
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.revoke_tokens_requires_owner_or_admin_before_the_id_check
entries.docstring:
`revokeRunTokens` refuses an unscoped caller whose role is neither owner nor admin with
`403 run_token_revoke_forbidden`, before it checks the path id: a malformed id from such a caller is
still `403`, not `400`.

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (keyHash : String) (now : Nat), (∀ (k : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), k ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.apiKeys → k.get "key_hash" = some keyHash → (k.get "revoked_at").isSome = true ∨ (k.get "expires_at").isSome = true ∧ AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.after (k.get "expires_at") now = false) → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.authenticateApiKey st keyHash now = none
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.revoked_or_expired_api_key_selects_no_workspace
entries.docstring:
A revoked or expired API key selects no workspace: when every `api_keys` row with the presented
hash is revoked, or carries an expiry that is not after `now`, authentication answers nothing (a
revoked, expired and unknown key are indistinguishable).

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (ws runId : String), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.IdsDistinct (st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.runs) → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.findRunForPrincipal st ws runId = List.find? (fun x => AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.colIs x "id" runId) (AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.workspaceView st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.runs ws)
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.run_lookup_is_scoped_to_the_caller
entries.docstring:
`findRunForPrincipal` is a lookup inside the caller's workspace: with run ids unique (the
primary key), it answers the run of that id among the caller's workspace's runs, and nothing
else — the run of another workspace and an absent run are both `null`.

entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (route : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RunRoute) (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (caller : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RunCaller) (runId : String) (k : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row → Except AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RunProblem α), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.IdsDistinct (st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.runs) → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.runPreflight route caller runId = none → (∀ (r : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.Row), r ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.runs → r.get "id" = some runId → r.get "workspace_id" ≠ some caller.workspaceId) → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.runRoute route st caller runId k = Except.error { status := 404, code := "run_not_found", message := "no run " ++ runId ++ " in this workspace." }
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.run_route_answers_404_for_absent_or_foreign_runs
entries.docstring:
Once a run route's own preflight has passed (for `revoke-tokens` its scope gate, role gate and
id check; for the other three routes the id check), it answers `404 run_not_found` with the message
"no run <id> in this workspace." for a run id with no run in the caller's workspace — whether the id
names no run at all or a run of another workspace — before the handler reads the run: never
`403`.

entries.statement: ∀ (route : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RunRoute) (caller : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RunCaller) (runId : String), (route = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RunRoute.revokeTokens → caller.browserScoped = false ∧ (caller.role = "owner" ∨ caller.role = "admin")) → (AgentWorkspace.Uuid.isCanonical runId = false → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.runPreflight route caller runId = some { status := 400, code := "invalid_run_id", message := "the run id in the path is not a UUID." }) ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Uuid.isCanonical runId = true → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.runPreflight route caller runId = none)
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.run_route_checks_the_id_after_its_gates
entries.docstring:
A run route whose earlier gates passed (every caller, for `read`, `events` and `interrupt`; an
unscoped owner or admin, for `revoke-tokens`) answers `400 invalid_run_id` for a path id that is not
a canonical UUID, and passes a canonical one on to the lookup.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.session_for_another_workspace_is_refused
entries.docstring: `Principal.fromSession` refuses a workspace whose slug is not the verified session's.

entries.statement: ∀ (st : AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.State) (claims : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.SessionClaims) (p : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.RequestPrincipal), AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.identifySessionCurrent st claims = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.Resolution.workspace p → (∃ w, w ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspaces ∧ w.get "slug" = some claims.ws ∧ w.get "id" = some p.workspaceId) ∧ (∃ pr, pr ∈ st AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.workspacePrincipals ∧ pr.get "id" = some p.principalId ∧ pr.get "workspace_id" = some p.workspaceId ∧ pr.get "revoked_at" = none) ∧ p.via = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.Via.session ∧ p.scope = none
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.session_principal_is_in_the_session_workspace
entries.docstring:
A session selects the workspace its verified slug names: the principal's workspace id is that
`workspaces` row's id, and its principal is an unrevoked `workspace_principals` row of that same
workspace; it is a `session` principal with no browser-token scope.

entries.statement: AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.resolveMembership AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.foreignMembershipFirst✝ "ada@example.com" "one" = some { principalId := "p1", userId := "u1", userLabel := "Ada", workspaceId := "w1", role := "owner" } ∧ ∃ p, AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.identifySessionCurrent AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.foreignMembershipFirst✝ { sub := "ada@example.com", ws := "one" } = AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.Resolution.workspace p ∧ p.workspaceId = "w1" ∧ p.principalId = "p1"
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.session_selects_target_membership_after_foreign_first
entries.docstring:
`resolveMembership` must skip a same-user membership of another workspace and return the
membership principal from the workspace named by the verified session slug.

entries.statement: ∀ (claims : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.SessionClaims) (ws : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.SessionWorkspace) (role : String) (identity : AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.MemberIdentity), ws.slug = claims.ws → AgentWorkspace.Text.isBlank identity.principalId = true ∨ AgentWorkspace.Text.isBlank identity.userId = true ∨ AgentWorkspace.Text.isBlank identity.label = true → AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.fromSession claims ws role identity = Except.error AgentWorkspace.Authz.Tenancy.SessionRefusal.incompleteIdentity
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.session_with_a_blank_identity_is_refused
entries.docstring:
`Principal.fromSession` refuses an identity whose principal id, user id or label is blank, even
for the session's own workspace.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.tenant_scope_rejections_follow_the_field_order
entries.docstring:
`validateTenantSessionScope` names the first field that fails, in order: not an object; a
`configDir` that is missing or not a string; a blank `configDir`; a `projectKey` that is missing or
not a string; a key failing the SDK pattern; a Windows device name.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.tenant_scope_verdict_has_two_arms
entries.docstring:
`validateTenantSessionScope` has two arms and no third: it answers `ok` exactly when the input
is an object whose `configDir` is a non-blank string and whose `projectKey` is a string the SDK's
own validator accepts and that names no Windows device, and then it returns both unchanged.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.via_wire_spellings
entries.docstring:
The three credential kinds are spelled `session`, `api-key` and `browser-token` on the wire, in
`principal.ts`'s order (transcribed independently from §3.1's table).

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.windows_device_names_are_refused_in_any_case
entries.docstring:
The Windows device names (`con`, `prn`, `aux`, `nul`, `com0`–`com9`, `lpt0`–`lpt9`) are refused
as project keys in any letter case, while near misses (`com10`, `console`, `nul_`, `lpt`, `coma`)
are accepted.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.AuthzTenancy.workspace_id_is_a_valid_project_key
entries.docstring:
A workspace id (a canonical UUID) is always an accepted project key: `sandboxFor` uses the
workspace id as `projectKey`, and the SDK's validator accepts its 36 characters unchanged, so no
run's tenant session key is ever silently dropped.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.a_catalogued_skill_may_be_unassigned
entries.docstring:
"A resource can sit in the catalog, owned and readable, without being assigned to anything":
some consistent state holds a skill that no agent is assigned.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.a_connectors_secret_cannot_be_deleted_under_it
entries.docstring:
"Deleting a secret a connector authenticates with must be an explicit decision": the
connector's secret reference is `ON DELETE RESTRICT`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.a_grant_is_binary
entries.docstring:
"It is not a general ACL — there is no `access` column, because 'permitted' is binary": a
grant row has no `access` column, while a file assignment does.

entries.docstring:
"`authType` defaults to `none`": a create body with no `authType`, or with `null`, is parsed
as `none`.

entries.statement: ∀ (b : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.Body), b.kind = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.Field.absent ∨ b.kind = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.Field.str "mcp" → AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.admit (some b) = Except.map AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.Admission.mcp (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.parseBody (some b))
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.admit_absent_kind_is_the_mcp_rule
entries.docstring:
"A body without `kind` is an MCP connector" (ADR-0113 C15): a create body whose `kind` is
absent or `"mcp"` is admitted exactly as the unchanged MCP rule parses it, errors included.

entries.statement: ∀ (b : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.Body), b.kind ≠ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.Field.absent → (∀ (s : String), b.kind = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.Field.str s → ¬s ∈ ["mcp", "openapi", "postgres"]) → AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.admit (some b) = Except.error [AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.kindError]
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.admit_refuses_an_unknown_kind
entries.docstring:
"`kind` is one of `mcp`, `openapi`, `postgres`": a create body whose `kind` is present but
not exactly one of those spellings (`null`, a non-string, or any other string, `"MCP"` included)
is refused with the single kind error, whatever its other fields are.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.admit_tool_kind_defers
entries.docstring:
"Tools are catalog connectors of kind `openapi` or `postgres`": a create body naming a tool
kind is handed to that kind's own schema without the MCP rule reading any other field, so no
MCP error can reach a tool body.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.admitted_path_has_no_empty_or_dot_segment

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.agent_instructions_are_untrimmed_and_bounded
entries.docstring:
"`agents.instructions`: any string, empty included … this is **not** trimmed": a string is
accepted, unchanged, exactly when it has at most 100 000 UTF-16 code units, so the empty string
and a block with surrounding whitespace pass as sent, 100 000 letters pass and 100 001 fail.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.agent_model_null_is_the_default
entries.docstring:
"`agents.model`: a non-blank provider-side model id, or `null` for the workspace default":
`null` is the default, a padded id is trimmed, and a blank id is refused with a pointer to
`null`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.agent_name_is_trimmed_and_bounded
entries.docstring:
"`agents.name`: a non-blank string, trimmed, at most `AGENT_NAME_MAX_LENGTH` characters", the
bound "applied to the trimmed value" and measured in UTF-16 code units: a string is accepted, as
its trimmed form, exactly when that form is not empty and has at most 200 code units; padding is
trimmed, a blank name is refused, 200 letters are 200 units and 100 astral characters are 200
units while 101 are 202.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.catalog_name_bounds
entries.docstring:
The HTTP bounds of an agent: its name and its model are at most 200 characters, like a
connector's name, and its instructions at most 100 000, while a skill name is bounded by 64.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.connector_args_only_for_stdio
entries.docstring: "`args` only with `stdio`": a valid connector with arguments is a `stdio` connector.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.connector_credential_iff_auth_type_is_not_none
entries.docstring:
"`credential` is required iff `authType !== 'none'`": a valid connector row references a
credential secret exactly when its authentication type is not `none`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.connector_has_credential_iff_it_needs_one
entries.docstring:
A valid connector's resource says it has a credential exactly when its authentication type
needs one.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.connector_has_exactly_one_of_command_and_url
entries.docstring:
The one-of of `mcp_servers`: a valid connector has exactly one of a command and a URL, and
which one is decided by the transport.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.connector_is_an_mcp_servers_row
entries.docstring: "Connectors (MCP servers)": a connector is exactly a row of `mcp_servers`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.connector_name_is_one_to_200_code_points
entries.docstring:
"`name` 1–200 code points": the connector name bound is `CONNECTOR_NAME_MAX_LENGTH`, 200, and
the create pattern admits exactly one to 200 code points with no line terminator.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.connector_resource_reveals_only_that_a_credential_exists
entries.docstring:
"The credential is write-only: `hasCredential` says whether one is on file": two rows that
differ only in which secret they reference, but both have one or both have none, render the same
resource.

entries.statement: ∀ (c : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.Connector), c.valid = true → (c.url.isSome = true ↔ c.transport.isRemote = true) ∧ Option.all AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Connector.urlShape c.url = true
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.connector_url_only_for_remote_and_absolute
entries.docstring:
"`url` must start with `http(s)://` and only with `http`/`sse`": a valid connector has a URL
exactly when its transport is remote, and every URL it has is absolute `http(s)`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.connector_wire_carries_no_credential_field
entries.docstring:
"No field a credential value could occupy": `ConnectorResourceSchema` has no key that starts
with `credential`, and carries `hasCredential` instead.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.create_refuses_a_missing_or_a_superfluous_credential
entries.docstring:
"`credential` is required iff `authType !== 'none'`" at the create route: a `bearer` body
with no credential and a `none` body with one are both refused, naming the field.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.create_refuses_fields_of_the_other_transport
entries.docstring:
"Only with `http`/`sse`" and "`args` only with `stdio`" at the create route: a `stdio` body
with a URL and a remote body with a command and arguments are refused, naming each field.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.documented_file_paths
entries.docstring:
"Paths are workspace-relative, forward-slash, no `..`": spec §16's own example path is
admitted, and a leading slash, a trailing slash, an empty segment, a `.` or `..` segment and a
control character are refused.

entries.statement: AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape "release-notes" = true ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape "release-notes-v2" = true ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape "a" = true ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape (String.ofList (List.replicate 64 'a')) = true ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape (String.ofList (List.replicate 65 'a')) = false ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape "-notes" = false ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape "notes-" = false ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape "Notes" = false ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape "release_notes" = false ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape "notes.md" = false ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Skill.nameShape "" = false
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.documented_skill_names
entries.docstring:
The names the docs use are skill names (`release-notes`, `release-notes-v2`),
and the pattern's edges hold: 64 characters pass, 65 fail, and a leading or trailing hyphen, an
upper-case letter, an underscore or a dot fails.

entries.statement: ∀ (f : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.File), f.valid = true → (f.kind = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.FileKind.folder → f.storageKey = none ∧ f.sizeBytes = 0 ∧ f.contentType = none) ∧ (f.kind = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.File.FileKind.file → f.storageKey.isSome = true ∧ 0 ≤ f.sizeBytes)
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.file_and_folder_rows
entries.docstring:
"A folder occupies no bytes and has no MIME type", and "a file has bytes somewhere and a
folder does not": in a valid row a folder has no storage key, size 0 and no content type, and a
file has a storage key and a non-negative size.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptCatalog.general_agent_is_an_ordinary_row

is refused, except a field whose `null` is itself a value (`allowedDomains`, BH061-080).

is accepted alone, all of them together are accepted, an empty body is accepted, and the id or an
unknown key is refused.

id; the resource adds only the id, the workspace and the two timestamps; the four required members
alone make an accepted body, and a body carrying the id is refused.

`memoryMb`, `diskMb`, `timeoutSeconds` and `idleTimeoutSeconds` are positive safe integers:
0, -1, 0.5 and `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1` are refused, 1 and `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` accepted.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.provider_is_not_patchable
entries.docstring: A model connection's provider is set once at creation: it is not a field `PATCH` accepts.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.rule_is_the_documented_table
entries.docstring:
The model's provider config rule is the documented table: it lists every provider once, in
`MODEL_PROVIDERS` order, and each provider's accepted and required fields are the table's.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.runtime_connection_create_requires_every_field
entries.docstring:
Creating a runtime connection requires all four of its name, driver, endpoint and credential:
the four are accepted and dropping any one is refused.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.runtime_connection_is_a_secret_reference
entries.docstring:
A runtime profile's connection is a `secrets` row: both keys over `runtime_connection_id`
reference `secrets`, one of them paired with the workspace.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.runtime_connection_resource_has_no_endpoint_or_credential
entries.docstring: The runtime-connection resource carries neither the endpoint nor the credential.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.runtime_connection_values_are_not_blank
entries.docstring:
A runtime connection's name and endpoint must not be blank and its credential must not be
empty; a credential of spaces is accepted.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.sandbox_runtime_profile_create_requires_a_pinned_image

A secret's create body needs both its name and its value and its replace body exactly its value;
each refuses a missing field and an unknown key.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.secret_name_boundaries
entries.docstring:
A name that is empty, lower case, starts with a digit or underscore, contains a hyphen or
space, or exceeds 128 characters is refused; 128 characters are accepted.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.secret_name_is_not_replaceable
entries.docstring: A secret's name is immutable: no replace body that carries a `name` is accepted.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.secret_operations_today_and_target
entries.docstring:
Secrets can be listed, created, replaced and removed today, which is exactly the documented
target: the target is the three original operations plus removal and nothing else.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.secret_resource_has_no_value_field
entries.docstring: The secret resource has no field that could carry the value or any part of its envelope.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.secret_value_bounds
entries.docstring: A value is 1 to 65 536 code units: empty and 65 537 are refused, 1 and 65 536 accepted.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.secret_values_are_bytea
entries.docstring:
There is no column a plaintext value fits: every value-bearing column of `secrets` is a
`NOT NULL` `bytea`, and the table has no `text` column besides the name, algorithm and
master-key id.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.sha256_pin_boundaries
entries.docstring:
The `sha256` pin rule: a reference with a digest of 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits at the end
is pinned; a tag, an upper-case, short or long digest, an empty reference before `@`, a line break
in the reference and a trailing newline are not.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.spec_example_names_are_valid
entries.docstring: The secret names spec §23 gives as examples are valid names.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptConfiguration.vercel_sandbox_profile_create_requires_a_pinned_image
entries.docstring: Creating a `vercel-sandbox` runtime profile accepts no image or a sha256-pinned image and refuses a tagged or non-string image.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.a_person_holds_at_most_one_role_per_workspace
entries.docstring:
"A person holds at most one role per workspace": `(workspace_id, user_id)` is a unique
constraint of `memberships`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.a_slug_selects_at_most_one_workspace
entries.docstring:
A slug selects at most one workspace: `workspaces_slug_key` is a unique index on the
`NOT NULL` column `slug`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.an_oidc_subject_binds_exactly_one_user
entries.docstring:
"One (issuer, subject) binds to exactly one user, forever": the pair is a unique constraint,
and its `user_id` is `NOT NULL` and references `users`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.api_key_acts_with_one_role
entries.docstring:
"It holds one role fixed at mint time": the key's role is one column of its row, not a scope
list, and the principal it authenticates as has exactly that role.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.api_key_has_no_user_and_no_membership
entries.docstring:
"An API key has no user behind it and no membership row; it *is* the principal": `api_keys`
has no `user_id` and no `membership_id`, and the principal an API key authenticates as names no
user.

A key is admitted only through its own principal: the principal row must be in the key's
workspace and name exactly this key as its source.

and the principal row active.

An API key's state follows `revoked > expired > active`, and an expiry that has exactly
arrived is expired (`expires_at > now` is what admits a key).

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.browser_token_carries_no_role
entries.docstring:
"The minting principal's role is re-read from the directory on every request, never carried in
the token": a browser-token row has no role column, and names its minter by a `NOT NULL`
principal id.

entries.docstring:
A browser token whose minter no longer resolves — its principal row revoked, its membership
gone, or its minting key revoked or expired — is not admitted, whatever the token row and its scope
say.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.browser_token_grammar_is_the_api_key_grammar
entries.docstring:
"The same anchored fixed-length grammar as `ak_live_` — a 22-character public half and a
43-character secret half": a browser token's halves have exactly an API key's lengths, and only the
prefix differs.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.browser_token_is_attenuation_not_a_fourth_identity
entries.docstring:
"Attenuation, not a fourth identity": a browser-token principal is its minter's identity —
the same principal, kind, workspace, user and key — with `via = browser-token` and the scope
attached.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.browser_token_is_scoped_to_exactly_one_run_or_session
entries.docstring:
"A browser token is scoped to exactly one run or session": the row of any browser token sets
exactly one of `run_id` and `session_id`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.browser_token_owns_and_acts_as_its_minter
entries.docstring:
A browser token owns as its minter owns and acts as its minter acts: both identifiers are the
minter's.

§3.1.1 "Revocation": a browser token stops authenticating when its `expiresAt` passes, when its
scoped run reaches `cancelled`, `completed` or `failed`, when its scoped session is archived, or when
its minting principal is revoked.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.browser_token_without_its_scoped_row_is_refused
entries.docstring: A browser token whose scoped run or session row is gone is not admitted.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.credential_hashes_are_globally_unique
entries.docstring:
"Key hashes are globally unique, because presentation looks a key up by it", and so are
browser-token hashes: neither unique key includes `workspace_id`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.credentials_never_appear_in_resources
entries.docstring:
"Shown once": neither the API-key resource nor the invitation resource has a field for the
secret or its hash.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.display_prefix_cannot_authenticate
entries.docstring:
"`ak_live_<key id>` … cannot authenticate": a string of the display-prefix shape is neither a
presented API key nor a presented browser token.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.every_membership_and_api_key_carries_one_of_four_roles
entries.docstring:
"Every membership and every API key carries exactly one of four roles": the `role` column of
`memberships` and of `api_keys` is `NOT NULL` and checked against exactly the four roles.

entries.docstring:
"An expired row is still pending until it is resent or revoked, so it continues to block a
duplicate": an invitation that `invitationStateOf` calls expired is still unresolved, and the
partial unique index refuses a second invitation to the same address beside it.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.hosted_api_key_owns_what_it_writes
entries.docstring:
A hosted API key, one that acts for no one, owns what it writes: the owner of the principal it
authenticates as is the key's own principal.

"A session proves identity; RBAC proves permission; a repository scope proves tenant
selection. None substitutes for another": no function of the user alone gives, over every
consistent state, the workspace or the role of that user's memberships, while the workspace
together with the user does fix the role.

"Every resource below belongs to exactly one [workspace]": each tenant-scoped identity table
has exactly one reference to `workspaces`, over a `NOT NULL` `workspace_id`.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.invitation_is_never_both_accepted_and_revoked
entries.docstring:
"An invitation is redeemed once … Accepted-then-revoked would be a row whose two terminal
timestamps disagree": a valid invitation is never both accepted and revoked.

entries.statement: ∀ (i : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Invitation.Invitation) (now : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Workspace.Instant), (i.revokedAt.isSome = true → i.stateAt now = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Invitation.InvitationState.revoked) ∧ (i.revokedAt = none → i.acceptedAt.isSome = true → i.stateAt now = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Invitation.InvitationState.accepted) ∧ (i.revokedAt = none → i.acceptedAt = none → i.expiresAt ≤ now → i.stateAt now = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Invitation.InvitationState.expired) ∧ (i.revokedAt = none → i.acceptedAt = none → now < i.expiresAt → i.stateAt now = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Invitation.InvitationState.pending)
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.invitation_state_precedence
entries.docstring:
"The four states … a consumer derives … with a fixed precedence": revoked, then accepted, then
expired (`expiresAt ≤ now`), then pending.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.invited_by_is_a_user_that_may_be_deleted
entries.docstring:
"`invited_by` references `users`, not `memberships` … `ON DELETE SET NULL`": the inviter is a
nullable user id that outlives the inviter's account, not a membership or a principal.

entries.statement: ∀ (i : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.ApiKeyIdentity) (a : String), i.actsForPrincipalId = some a → (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.fromApiKey i).ownerPrincipalId = a ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.fromApiKey i).principalId = i.principalId ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.fromApiKey i).me.principalId = i.principalId
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.local_key_owns_through_the_principal_it_acts_for
entries.docstring:
A local runtime key owns what it writes through the membership principal it acts for, while
the actor that audit, version authorship, minted tokens and `GET /api/me` record stays the key's own
principal.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.me_user_id_is_null_exactly_for_an_api_key
entries.docstring:
"`userId` is `null` for exactly an API-key principal": the `GET /api/me` view of any
well-formed authenticated principal has a user id exactly when it is a membership.

entries.statement: ∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.Principal) (mid : AgentWorkspace.MembershipId), p.source = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.Source.membership mid → p.actsFor = none → ∀ (present : Bool) (now : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Workspace.Instant) (target : Option AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.ActsForRow), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.principalResolves p (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.SourceRow.membership present) now target = (p.active && present)
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.membership_minter_resolves_iff_active_and_present
entries.docstring:
A membership-minted principal (which acts for no one, `workspace_principals_acts_for_api_key_only`)
resolves exactly while its principal row is active and its membership row stands.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.membership_owns_what_it_writes
entries.docstring:
A session's principal (a membership re-read from the directory) owns what it writes, whatever
acts-for value the record carries.

entries.statement: AgentWorkspace.Concepts.ApiKey.prefix_ = "ak_live_" ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.ApiKey.idLength = 22 ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.ApiKey.secretLength = 43 ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.prefix_ = "awt_live_" ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.idLength = 22 ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.secretLength = 43 ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.ApiKey.presentedShaped (AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.sampleBearer "ak_live_" 22 43) = true ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.ApiKey.presentedShaped (AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.sampleBearer "ak_live_" 21 43) = false ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.ApiKey.presentedShaped (AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.sampleBearer "ak_live_" 22 44) = false ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.presentedShaped (AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.sampleBearer "awt_live_" 22 43) = true ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.presentedShaped (AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.sampleBearer "awt_live_" 23 43) = false ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.presentedShaped (AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.sampleBearer "awt_live_" 22 42) = false
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.presented_bearers_follow_the_credential_table
entries.docstring:
"`Authorization: Bearer ak_live_<22>_<43>`" and "`awt_live_<22>_<43>`": the key grammar is
the prefix `ak_live_`, a 22-character public half and a 43-character secret half; the browser-token
grammar is the same with the prefix `awt_live_`; and each accepts exactly those half lengths.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.principal_is_a_membership_or_an_api_key_never_a_bare_user
entries.docstring:
"A principal is … a membership … or an API key … Never a bare user": a principal row has no
`user_id` column, its kind is one of the two sources, and every source is one of the two kinds.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.principal_sources_cascade
entries.docstring:
"The source pair is tenant-paired … Deleting a membership cascades its principal row away":
both source keys of `workspace_principals` are `ON DELETE CASCADE` (a removed membership's
principal is deleted, not revoked).

entries.statement: ∀ (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.Principal) (now : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Workspace.Instant), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.principalResolves p (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.SourceRow.membership false) now = false ∧ ∀ (t : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.BrowserToken) (target : Option AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.ScopedRow), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.browserTokenAdmitted t target p (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.SourceRow.membership false) now = false
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.removed_membership_no_longer_resolves
entries.docstring:
A membership principal whose membership row is gone no longer resolves, and a browser token it
minted is no longer admitted, whatever the principal row, the token row and the scope say.

entries.statement: ∀ (k : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.ApiKey.ApiKey) (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.Principal) (now : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Workspace.Instant), p.active = false → AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Principal.apiKeyAdmitted k p now = false
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.revoked_principal_never_admits_its_api_key
entries.docstring:
"Revoking an API key sets `api_keys.revoked_at` and `workspace_principals.revoked_at`": a key
whose principal row is revoked is not admitted, however live the key row itself is.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.the_role_is_on_the_membership_not_the_user
entries.docstring:
"A user is deliberately NOT workspace-scoped … Anything that differs per workspace — a role
… — belongs on `memberships`": `users` has neither `workspace_id` nor `role`, `memberships` has
both.

entries.statement: ∀ (ttl : Nat), (AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.ttlAccepted ttl = true ↔ 60 ≤ ttl ∧ ttl ≤ 3600) ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.ttlAccepted AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.defaultTtlSeconds = true ∧ AgentWorkspace.Concepts.BrowserToken.defaultTtlSeconds = 300
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.token_ttl_is_bounded
entries.docstring:
"`60 ≤ ttlSeconds ≤ 3600`, default `300`": the mint request admits exactly the TTLs in the
closed interval, and the default is inside it.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.workspace_default_model_is_one_pair
entries.docstring:
"Written and cleared as one pair, never one without the other": a workspace's row sets the
default connection exactly when it sets the default model.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptIdentity.workspace_is_archived_iff_stamped
entries.docstring: The two states of a workspace are `active` (no archive stamp) and `archived`.

entries.statement: ∀ (r : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.PublishRequest) (role : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Membership.Role) (pse re : Bool) (now : Nat) (p : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.Published), r.subjectType = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.SubjectType.agent → r.mode = none → AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.publishDecision r role pse re now = AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.PublishOutcome.published p → p.mode = some AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.Mode.definition ∧ p.budgetCapUsd = none
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptPublication.agent_share_defaults_to_definition
entries.docstring:
"Definition sharing is the default": an admitted agent share published without a mode is a
`definition` share, and it carries no budget.

entries.statement: ∀ (s : AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.Share), s.budgetCapUsd = some "20" → (s.spentUsd = "20.000000" → s.budgetExhausted = true) ∧ (s.spentUsd = "19.999999" → s.budgetExhausted = false)
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptPublication.budget_is_exhausted_at_the_cap
entries.docstring:
"Budget cap $20 total, then the link stops accepting messages": a runnable share whose spend
has reached its cap is exhausted, and one below its cap is not.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptPublication.budget_must_be_positive
entries.docstring:
"`budgetCapUsd`: a positive amount in USD": zero and negative budgets are refused, any positive
amount is accepted.

entries.statement: ∀ (m : Option AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.Mode) (i tr d : Bool), AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.optionsFit AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.SubjectType.agent m i true tr d = true → m = some AgentWorkspace.Concepts.Share.Mode.runnable
entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptPublication.budget_requires_runnable_mode
entries.docstring:
"`budgetCapUsd` further requires `runnable` mode": an agent command with a budget that fits
is a runnable one.

entries.name: AgentWorkspace.Theorems.Normative.ConceptPublication.charge_is_keyed_by_the_run
entries.docstring:
"`run_id` is the primary key because a run may be funded by at most one share": the charge
table is keyed by the run alone.

"shares_created_by_users_id_fk" = some (["created_by"], AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.users, ["id"], AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.OnDelete.restrict) ∧ (AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.catalogue AgentWorkspace.Er.Core.TableName.shares).foreignKeySignature?
